common.seeWhatsNew: See what's new in the latest Kurrier release.

v4_4_0.title: More connected, more reliable
v4_4_0.description: Connect Microsoft 365 accounts, enjoy more reliable email synchronization, and work with files more easily in Drive.

microsoft365.title: Microsoft 365 support
microsoft365.description: Connect Microsoft email accounts securely with OAuth alongside your existing providers.

imapSync.title: More reliable email sync
imapSync.description: Improved real-time updates, mailbox discovery, and recovery from interrupted IMAP connections.

drive.title: A more capable Drive
drive.description: Drag and drop files, preview images and PDFs, and share files with expiring download links.

v4_2_0.title: Email signatures
v4_2_0.description: Create polished signatures for each identity and use them directly from the Kurrier composer.

emailSignatures.title: Signatures for every identity
emailSignatures.description: Create multiple signatures and choose separate defaults for new messages, replies and forwards.

composer.title: Composer integration
composer.description: Preview your signature while composing and quickly switch signatures or remove them before sending.

responsiveUi.title: Responsive signature editor
responsiveUi.description: Create and manage signatures with a streamlined editor that works across desktop and smaller displays.

v4_1_0.title: A better Kurrier
v4_1_0.description: This release brings improvements across mail reliability, the composer, responsive layouts and workspace management.

mailReliability.title: More reliable mail sync
mailReliability.description: Improved IMAP recovery and mailbox synchronization across long-running connections.

composer.title: Improved mail composer
composer.description: A more polished composing experience across desktop and mobile.

responsiveUi.title: Better responsive experience
responsiveUi.description: Mail views and workspace screens now adapt more naturally to smaller displays.
